tekst: Thorax is an up-and-coming all-round DJ taking the stage by storm. A set is full of variety: from timeless classics to modern beats, from sing-alongs to rave energy. There’s something for every generation and every mood.

punten.tekst: No fixed playlist: the set grows with the room, from the first drinks to the last track.
Parties, festivals, youth movements, company parties, birthdays and weddings.
A custom quote, invoicing available and a valid DJ licence (Unisono).
